QuestInfo.name: [Identisk] Someone's Help 1
QuestInfo.0:
The Sunlight Blessing still hasn't returned. 
The leader of Iden Island, #p9062961#, is flustered. 
Talk to them.
QuestInfo.1:
Iden Island has gotten chilly since the Sunlight Blessing disappeared.
A young Otter named#p9062966# has caught a cold. 
Ask around Iden Island and Tisk Island and see if anyone has medicine.
QuestInfo.2: No one in Identisk has medicine. Better go back and talk to #p9062961#.

speech.0: Do I have medicine to cure the cold? I'm afraid I used it all... What? Okya is sick? Oh no... What do we do?
Do I have medicine to cure the cold? The people of Tisk Island don't normally catch colds.
Ah... Do I have medicine to cure the cold? I used up the entire supply. What do we do?

default.0: Who has the medicine? What if no one has it?
